resolution.note: krn lane brief prints the brief behind lanePacket (the measured arm-B carrier, all repository records); test/cli/lane-brief.test.ts proves equality with evals/fr40/lanes.ts laneBrief for every frozen unit; krn-lead skill pipes lane briefs through it. Deviation: workerPacket's measured-record filter is not used, because the lane run measured the unfiltered selection.

title: Wire the FR-40 packet into the lead's lane dispatch brief
body:
Outcome: the lead's dispatch of a lane brief carries the FR-40 packet prefix (`packetBrief` over `workerPacket`), for example a `krn lane brief` command that prints the brief with the prefix, and the krn-lead skill uses it.
Why: D0 (t-5983e6g) kept the carrier: on Claude lanes B-A was +22.6 pp (33 wins, 3 losses, 90% [+15.4, +29.0]), token ratio 0.944 (evals/fr40/results-lanes.md). The measured carrier is `packetBrief(fr40Packet(id, 'brain'), brief)`; the lead's path has no consumer yet, and the wiring (command, help, test, skill text) is more than 20 lines.
Proof: a test that the command's output for a frozen unit prompt equals the lane runner's arm-B prompt (evals/fr40/lanes.ts laneBrief).
Scope: src/cli/lane.ts, src/brain/worker-packet.ts, .agents/skills/krn-lead.
